                                                  SPARKLE Travel Dock, USB4 40Gbps, 9 Ports of Connectivity, Single 8K/Dual 4K
                                                  Output, Dual Power Mode, Windows/MacOS Compatible, TD-8140

                                                  USB4 came with 40Gbps Upstream, as Thunderbolt, SPARKLE Travel Dock is ready to provide an
                                                  ultimate docking experience to any laptop scenario. With Dual Power mode, you can either find
                                                  yourself a quiet place plug and use; or place it on your desk and feed SPARKLE Travel Dock thru
                                                  Type-C and provide maximum 85W host charging. 9 ports of connectivity will give you everything
                                                  you need.
